summary: Banco Santander filed a Form 6-K reporting weekly buyback transactions under its previously announced share repurchase programme. Between 6 and 12 August 2026, the bank repurchased 20 million shares at weighted average prices around €12.84–12.97 per share across XMAD and CEUX venues. Cumulative purchases reached €4.65 billion, about 92.5% of the programme's maximum, representing roughly 17.8% of outstanding shares since 2021. This is a routine disclosure under EU Market Abuse Regulation; no new deal terms. What to watch: final tranche completion and any extension if the cap is reached.
